name: payment_terms_with_line_count
source_sql: SELECT t.id, t.name->>'en_US' AS name, t.sequence, t.early_discount, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_payment_term_line l WHERE l.payment_id = t.id) AS line_count FROM account_payment_term t

name: incoterm_codes
source_sql: SELECT id, code, name->>'en_US' AS name, active FROM account_incoterms

name: cash_roundings_with_relation_counts
source_sql: SELECT r.id, r.name->>'en_US' AS name, r.rounding, r.strategy, r.rounding_method, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_cash_rounding_res_currency_rel c WHERE c.account_cash_rounding_id = r.id) AS currencies, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_cash_rounding_account_payment_method_line_rel p WHERE p.account_cash_rounding_id = r.id) AS payment_method_lines FROM account_cash_rounding r

name: reports_with_line_column_section_counts
source_sql: SELECT r.id, r.name->>'en_US' AS name, r.sequence, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_report_line l WHERE l.report_id = r.id) AS lines, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_report_column c WHERE c.report_id = r.id) AS columns, (SELECT count(*) FROM account_report_section_rel s WHERE s.main_report_id = r.id) AS sections FROM account_report r

name: report_expressions_by_line
source_sql: SELECT id, report_line_id, label, engine, formula FROM account_report_expression
